1.title: Why Google wants to win the frontier conversation | Tulsee Doshi (Head of Product for Gemini)
1.author: Lenny's Podcast
1.hook: Head of Product for Gemini on frontier AI PM work: model development as craft (60-20-20 framework for balancing shipping vs. R&D), writing evals, why the model itself has UX, how PMs skill up in frontier labs, Google's full-stack strategy, and the rising value of PMs in AI companies.

2.title: OpenAI VP: How AI Changed My Family’s Fight Against Cancer | Ashley Alexander
2.author: Peter Yang
2.hook: VP of Product at OpenAI (Health) discusses using AI to support parents through cancer diagnosis and treatment — specific tactics: preparing for doctor visits, researching treatments, AI catching a risky treatment plan, and managing caregiver emotional load.

3.title: Persuasion Models Outperform Claude and ChatGPT | Dan Lee
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Dan Lee (Nooks CEO) discusses training open-weight models to outperform Claude/ChatGPT on sales tasks, frames sales as persuasion vs. reasoning, and debuts Node (sales AI assistant); backed by $500M non-dilutive capital from General Catalyst.

1.title: Eyes-Off Autonomous Driving Arrives by 2028 | Brandon Basso
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Brandon Basso (Wayve) discusses end-to-end AI models replacing modular self-driving stacks, how physical AI learns safety intrinsically, and timeline predictions for eyes-off autonomous systems by 2028.

2.title: Is AI Now Good Enough To Cure Cancer? | YC Paper Club
2.author: Y Combinator
2.hook: YC Paper Club on AI for biology: four researchers discuss how collapsing sequencing costs created a data problem in cancer care, what it takes to model cells vs molecules, what DNA language models learn, and emergent in-context learning in genome models.

1.title: Why Full AI Automation Fails in Production | Angela McNea
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Thread AI CEO explains why unconstrained AI agents fail in production — argues for explicit decision logic and human intervention points; draws on Palantir lessons and Army DevCom deployments; covers how software work changes when you can't fully automate.

2.title: Frontier AI Models Have Gotten Worse at Writing | Ben Hylak
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Ben Hylak (Raindrop CTO) discusses why frontier models degrade at specific tasks as they scale, how to monitor agent failures in production, and the simulation-based approach to safely testing model upgrades without silent failures.
